shared_tail.surface: محمد بن عمرو بن الحسن بن علي

notes: The two branches meet at شعبة; the names after him (سعد بن إبراهيم، محمد بن عمرو، جابر) are written once and belong to both
«ابن، بشار» is written so in the text (a comma inside the name) and is kept as written; it is not completed
جابر is the last link: «فسألنا جابر بن عبد الله فقال» makes his answer the saying; «الحجاج» in the scene is not a link
